message: Your brief is in BRIEF.md in this folder. Your last message is your reply: the painting's title if you give it one and a few sentences about the picture. At the end of each sitting, leave a handoff in your journal and last reply: passages still unresolved, practical lessons to carry forward from what you observed and recipes that failed. Before retrying a failed recipe, identify what has changed and why that could address the observed failure. Carry forward the conditions of material trials and repairs: substrate and wetness, recipe ratios, medium or thinner, load, coverage and viewed result; label broader rules as hypotheses. final:
**Two Embers and a Blue Jug**

A cool blue vessel anchors folded linen and two glowing persimmons against a quiet violet wall.

Handoff: angular shadows and mottled ceramic remain deliberately unresolved. Connected repainting worked better than isolated modeling stripes; narrow shadow repairs created unwanted pedestals. Trial conditions, failed recipes, and uncertainties are recorded in the journal.
